definitions.explanation: The regional brand name for male snow crab caught off Fukui Prefecture (the old Echizen province) and landed at its ports — one of Japan's most famous and expensive winter crab brands.

examples.japanese: {越前蟹|えちぜんがに}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{食|た}べに⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: We are going to eat Echizen crab.

examples.japanese: {越前蟹|えちぜんがに}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{黄色|きいろ}い→黄色い：00959_kiiroi⟧⟦タグ→タグ：11034_tagu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{付|つ}いている→付く：01960_tsuku⟧。
examples.english: Echizen crab has a yellow tag attached to it.

examples.japanese: {福井県|ふくいけん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{毎年|まいとし}→毎年：00731_maitoshi⟧、{越前蟹|えちぜんがに}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{漁|りょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{解禁|かいきん}→解禁：14144_kaikin⟧されると⟦{観光客|かんこうきゃく}→観光客：03022_kankoukyaku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{賑|にぎ}わう→賑わう：14235_nigiwau⟧。
examples.english: In Fukui Prefecture, when the Echizen crab season opens each year, the area bustles with tourists.

notes:
{越前蟹|えちぜんがに} is biologically the same species as ズワイ{蟹|がに}; the name is a protected regional brand for crab landed at Fukui's ports, identified by a yellow tag clamped to one claw.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {越前蟹|えちぜんがに}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{解禁|かいきん}→解禁：14144_kaikin⟧: the opening of Echizen crab season
- {越前蟹|えちぜんがに}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦タグ→タグ：11034_tagu⟧: the Echizen crab brand tag

Other regional snow-crab brands include {松葉蟹|まつばがに} (Tottori/San'in) — the same species marketed under a different regional name.
